What's New

3.1.0

TBD
New
  • Sonar - a new free tab that makes effects react to your audio: drop in a project, pick the clips it should listen to, and hit Publish
  • What you select is what the effect hears
  • Effects stay in sync on export, where audio-reactive effects normally come out wrong or frozen, because Sonar listens to the audio up front rather than during the render
  • Uses the audio as Final Cut Pro plays it, so volume changes, fades, compressors and EQ are all included
  • Trial and licensing - Steno can now be tried before buying: unlicensed, the full flow works but exports stop at the first 5 captions or titles
  • Activating is one time: click Trial in the top bar, paste the license key from your Payhip receipt, and everything exports - no subscription, no re-activation
Improved
  • Standard Final Cut Pro role colours now signal the audio type on the timeline
  • Clicking a clip to hear it now plays straight away instead of pausing for about a second first
  • The playhead now follows what you hear rather than running slightly ahead
  • The transcription model list now shows each model's real download size and the memory it needs, like the Keyframeless AI model list - the Parakeet models previously claimed ~600 MB when their downloads are really 2.6-3 GB
Fixed
  • Temporary audio is now cleared out automatically - working files were never removed and could quietly build to many gigabytes over months, along with part-finished transcription model downloads
  • Fixed the Parakeet model download looking stuck: it ran a spinner with no numbers for a multi-gigabyte download - it now shows real percentage progress, and picks up where it left off if interrupted

3.0.1

2026-07-08
Fixed
  • Detached audio no longer shows up as two lanes
  • Fixed a freeze when loading projects with many split audio clips
  • Clips reassigned to a music or other non-dialogue role ignored

3.0.0

2026-07-07
New
  • Renamed AI Captions to Steno
  • Native caption generation in SRT, iTT, and CEA-608
  • FCP 12.3 subtitle support
  • SRT import workflow
  • Convert captions between formats
  • Full support for bundled audio filters, including the compressor
  • Diff preview for AI edits
  • Waveform rendering loader
  • Point, rotation, percentage, and dropdown fields for value customization
Improved
  • Smoother click-and-drag selection
  • Deselecting now clears all captions by default
  • Added a gap at the start of captions for easier syncing
  • Default Y position moved from 20% to 50% to suit non-centered templates
  • Replaced the slider with a freeform value field
  • Customize values side bar consistency
  • Switch Captions role to Subtitles matching FCP's direction
Fixed
  • Disabled compound clip audio is no longer detected
  • Disabled audio is no longer recognized
  • Overlay now appears on Process and Reprocess
  • Fixed a crash in the transcription list
  • Custom templates now render text correctly
  • Custom templates now replace placeholder text
  • Custom templates now work with text filters (outline and drop shadow)
Changelog begins at 3.0.0.
Keyframeless X is a Final Cut Pro workflow extension, part of the Keyframeless suite.
